summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of HOMEWORK coaching platform (Next.js 15 + React 19). Backend API endpoints working perfectly (11/11 tests passed). Frontend UI, navigation, SEO, accessibility all working correctly. CRITICAL BUG: Server Actions failing due to Next.js security check blocking form submissions in production environment.

integration_issues.issue: Server Actions failing with 500 error - Next.js security check blocking submissions due to x-forwarded-host mismatch
integration_issues.error_message: `x-forwarded-host` header with value `fullstack-coach-app.preview.emergentagent.com` does not match `origin` header with value `fullstack-coach-app.cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud` from a forwarded Server Actions request
integration_issues.root_cause: Kubernetes ingress/proxy setup causes origin header mismatch. Next.js Server Actions security check blocks the request.
integration_issues.suggested_fix: Add serverActions.allowedOrigins configuration to next.config.mjs to allow the forwarded host

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix Next.js Server Actions security issue preventing form submissions. Add serverActions.allowedOrigins to next.config.mjs to allow the forwarded host 'fullstack-coach-app.preview.emergentagent.com'. Error: x-forwarded-host header mismatch causes 500 error on all Server Action calls. Both lead form and contact form are blocked. Backend API endpoints work perfectly when called directly (tested via curl), but Server Actions fail due to Next.js security check in the Kubernetes/proxy environment.
